rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority together by writing a Fisher II-style narrow-tailoring reversal that purports not to overrule Bakke/Grutter/Fisher II, attracting Kavanaugh and Barrett. Thomas is highly likely to write separately to press a categorical Title VI textual bar, with additional concurrences possible from Alito and/or Gorsuch, and a principal dissent likely authored by Sotomayor or Kagan.
